source_pool: second-step solver-native residuals derived deterministically from the preexisting R8A legacy roots
construction: Start from every R8A frozen first-step residual in deterministic order.
Choose the first occurrence-order variable of that residual as the second pivot.
Create both second-pivot restrictions False and True.
Build the R9 restriction frame/delta relative to the first-step residual parent.
Eligibility uses structural observables only: frame class GENERAL_CNF, 4 <= bridge_size <= 16, and formula hash not equal to either R12B exposed world hash.
Sort eligible worlds by formula_sha256 and take the first six. No SAT/UNSAT truth, DPLL result, exact interface, or R12B outcome participates in selection.
reason: This creates states not used to fit R12B while retaining a finite independent bridge witness and a deterministic truth-blind selection rule.
